fusions.name: Still Air
fusions.desc: Lays a cone of slack cord ahead of you, dealing 14 damage to everything caught in it. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Basking Snare
fusions.desc: Casts a strand that deals 4 damage. The target is [Hindered], attacking 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Still
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Warm Reserve
fusions.desc: When your health is full, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 20 seconds.
